text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I came to the shrine to pray together 
with Air Messiah, who has been feeling a 
bit off lately—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"There seems to be trash scattered around. 
...I will go speak to the head priest."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I've received permission, so I shall go 
clean. Trainer, as for you—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. Well then, 
together.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it. I used to do 
something similar when I was little.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
There was a large, unused storage room... 
It bothered me that it was completely 
covered in dust, so I cleaned it up.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, by myself. It was dirty so I cleaned 
it, that's all it was... I didn't think it 
was something worth bringing up.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
“Still, when I finished cleaning one day 
and stepped outside— my mother was waiting 
for me.”

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even though I was covered in dust... you 
hugged me without a moment's hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...It wasn't that I wanted to be praised. 
But my mother was watching me. I was... 
truly happy."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The shrine was noticeably cleaner now. 
Even the breeze brushing against our 
cheeks felt somewhat refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It ended up taking the whole day. I wish I 
could've finished it faster.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for accompanying me. Let us 
head back before it gets any later."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking around, the brooms and rags we 
used were nowhere to be seen. Neither were 
the trash bags filled with fallen leaves.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It turns out Air Messiah had cleaned it up 
before I even noticed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Accomplishing things out of everyone's 
sight... To Air Messiah, that must simply 
be second nature."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It has gotten completely dark. Please 
watch your step on the stairs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She probably has no need for words of 
gratitude. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —Oh, there's no need to thank me. ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure was mine, thank you so much 
for today. I was really happy to have you 
there with me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...*pant*... *pant*. How was my time, if I 
may ask?
choice_data_list:
You've closed the gap quite a bit since 
yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The wind was pushing me from behind. It 
seems I'm in good shape today.
choice_data_list: Maybe it's thanks to all the cleaning?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that the gods were watching 
over me? Fufu... If so, I am deeply 
honored."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah smiles and asks for one more 
lap. Bit by bit, she began regaining her 
form.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...*pant*... *pant*. It seems... I haven't 
gotten back into shape yet.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "...Excuse me. One more lap, please."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah seems thoroughly exhausted. It 
looks like it will take some time for her 
to recover her condition.
